name: std::basic_ios<CharT,Traits>::setstate
intro: Sets the stream error flags state in addition to currently set flags. Essentially calls clear(rdstate() | state). May throw an exception.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
state

 -

 stream error state flags to set. It can be a combination of the following constants:



 Constant

 Explanation




 goodbit

 no error




 badbit

 irrecoverable stream error




 failbit

 input/output operation failed (formatting or extraction error)




 eofbit

 associated input sequence has reached end-of-file

examples.output:
stream is not fail
now stream is fail
and stream is not good
